theme: Light theme (optimal for data-heavy operational dashboards)

rules: Do not use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Limit H1 size to text-3xl or text-4xl with tracking-tight to maintain a compact, data-friendly dashboard look.
Use 'tabular-nums' class for all numerical and currency data to ensure perfect vertical alignment.
Table headers and small labels must be uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em] (tracking-widest).
No full-screen gradients. Rely on stark contrast and crisp borders.
Never use transparent backgrounds for overlapping elements like sticky headers, modals, or dropdowns. Always use solid white or a heavily blurred glassmorphism with high opacity.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6 for summary stat cards.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing within cards (p-4 to p-6) to avoid text collision, maintaining a breathable but dense data layout.
grids_and_layouts.surfaces: Flat backgrounds, 1px solid border (border-gray-200), max 4px border-radius (rounded-sm). Avoid soft/muddy drop shadows; use shadow-sm only on hover or floating layers.

components.navigation: Top navigation or left sidebar containing 4 tabs: Dashboard, Sale Orders, Dispatch Orders, Masters.
components.tables: Use Shadcn UI tables. Implement compact cell padding, a distinct header row (bg-gray-50), and hover states for rows (hover:bg-gray-50).
components.forms: Multi-column grid layouts for main forms, and a full-width dynamic table for line-items. The 'Add Item' button should be visibly distinct.
components.badges: Pill-shaped, text-xs font-semibold for indicating order/dispatch statuses.

visual_enhancers.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react. 'Regular' weight for standard icons, 'Duotone' for large empty state or stat card icons.
visual_enhancers.motion: Keep it snappy. Minimal motion. Simple transition-colors and slight -translate-y-px on cards.
visual_enhancers.currency: All monetary values MUST use Indian Rupee (₹) and Indian number formatting (e.g., ₹ 1,23,456.00).

accessibility: All text must meet APCA/WCAG AA contrast standards.
Interactive elements must have high-contrast focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none).
instructions_to_main_agent: Rebuild the application using React (.js/.jsx, NOT TypeScript) + Tailwind CSS + FastAPI.
Use Shadcn UI components for complex inputs (Select for Customer/Brand/Salesman dropdowns, Dialog for modals).
Add 'data-testid' attributes to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, dropdowns) for testing automation.
Implement Indian Rupee formatting globally via Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'INR' }).
Handle empty states gracefully on all tables (Dashboard lists, Sale Orders, Dispatches).
Ensure dynamic line items compute the 'Amount' automatically (Rate * Qty) and display a live total at the bottom of the form.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not apply generic 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transition properties.
Do not center-align the main app container; text reading flow must remain left-aligned for data.
Hover states must explicitly set text color to ensure visibility (e.g., hover:bg-primary hover:text-white).
Use 'sonner' for all toast notifications (e.g., success/error on saves and exports).
